title: Carb Cycling Calculator
description: Build high, medium and low carb day macros from your TDEE using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
howto: Enter your stats and activity level.
Pick your goal (cut, maintain or gain).
Read your high, medium and low day calories and macros.

faqs.a: Alternating high-carb days (around training) with low-carb days. Protein stays constant; carbs and fats trade off to hit the calorie target.
BMR from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation (weight, height, age, sex) multiplied by an activity factor from 1.2 (sedentary) to 1.9 (very active).

faqs.q: Which days should be high carb?
faqs.a: Put high-carb days on your hardest training days and low-carb days on rest days.
